entities.title: Planet and sun
entities.summary: Placing the two bodies on arrival, the altitude check and crashing, the sun's heat and fuel scooping.
entities.purpose: Places the planet and the sun (RULES B.10.1) and runs the altitude and sun checks the flight tick makes every 32 ticks (B.14, B.15.1, B.15.2).
boundaries: A feature: it uses capabilities and other features, never a use case (tests/layers.rs).
It does not scoop objects; that is combat's contact step.
